name: Tasks
description: Tasks component with package screens for lists, priority views, task editing, subtasks, tags and activity. Full legacy parity remains unfinished.

navigation.label: Tasks
navigation.description: View tasks by list or priority, edit tasks, and manage subtasks, tags and comments. Account timezone, People, assistant policies and background jobs remain unfinished.

features.description: Tasks component with validated task, list, tag, activity, view preference and ordered breakdown routes. Seventeen tool handlers cover five reads and twelve task, list, tag, activity and breakdown actions. Full parity, assistant action policies and background jobs remain unfinished.

errors.description: A request has missing or invalid fields. Correct the field named in the validation message and retry.
A task or list is absent or unavailable to this account.
A data operation failed; internal details are withheld from the response.

features.description: Package screen using the shared UI kit, authored typography and parent bridge: task loading; list and priority views; status, list, text and tag filters; create and edit tasks; completion and suggestion review; list creation and renaming; subtasks; tag creation and assignment; activity comments; saved default view. Dates currently display in UTC. Full legacy screen and setting parity is unfinished.

remediations.description: Retry loading Tasks after checking the connection. Unsaved editor fields are retained on request failure.

errors.description: Tasks could not load or save a request. Check the connection and retry.

features.description: Task actions preserve tool-entered text, return legacy result summaries, and run in the account-scoped host transaction. Breakdown preserves step order and adds parent activity; the HTTP route trims steps. The host requires account approval for each tool invocation. Legacy automatic-action policies, presentations and installed chat integration remain unfinished.

errors.description: A tool input has missing fields or incorrect types. Correct the action inputs and retry.

features.description: Enqueue a status change for a visible task and apply it in the captured account context. The host supplies actor identity and metadata-only parameters. Queue retries and retention use host defaults; legacy queue options, optional request-key retention and recurrence jobs remain unfinished.

Read up to twenty owned open tasks due within a bounded horizon, including overdue tasks, with material revisions and the next time boundary. Shared tasks are excluded and recurrence is never advanced. Background authorization and scheduler integration remain unfinished.

tasks.get.description: Get a task with its subtasks and ten most recent activity entries.

tasks.listTags.description: List tags in a task list.

tasks.create.description: Create a task owned by the signed-in account.

tasks.update.description: Update a visible task using the current account permissions.

tasks.updateStatus.description: Complete, archive or reopen a task.

tasks.breakDown.description: Break an owned task into ordered subtasks.

tasks.addActivity.description: Add a note or activity entry to a visible task.

tasks.assignTag.description: Assign an owned tag to an owned task.

tasks.unassignTag.description: Remove a tag from an owned task.

tasks.createList.description: Create a task list for the signed-in account.

tasks.createTag.description: Create a tag in an owned task list.

tasks.heartbeatWindow.description: Read a bounded owner-only overdue/due-soon window and revision without advancing recurrence. Background scheduler integration remains unfinished.
